content:
anya: quick async — kernel-lab check-in. what I did: landed prefetch heuristic tweak in staging, ran a small microbatch perf sweep.

drew: saw the PR, left a couple nits on docstring. tiny ask: can you add a unit test for the new heuristic's boundary?

anya: yep will add a unit test today. test idea: simulate single-token repeated prefix to trigger fallback.

sam: perf numbers? curious about 8k vs 4k seq when batching.

li: quick bench (median p50/p95) from local run:
```
8k seq, batch=16 -> p50 132ms p95 290ms
4k seq, batch=32 -> p50 98ms p95 210ms
```
working on artifact to upload to S3.

maria: heads-up — saw intermittent KV evictions on staging during the sweep. not all nodes, maybe slot packing bug.

anya: noted. I can repro locally if you can share the trace IDs.

maria: trace ids: t-00123, t-00129. also saw a `kv_cache_eviction` spike aligned with microburst.

drew: could be the prefetch window + slot steal. we should guard prefetch to only run when slot_util < 0.75.

sam: +1 on guard. also pinging @ops-bot to check if any recent kernel rollout coincided.

ops-bot: deploy-log: rollout kernel-v3.7.2 started 1702504000, completed 1702504200, no failed nodes reported. :white_check_mark:

li: I have artifacts and a minimal repro harness, will upload link in a minute.

anya: blockers: need tests and repro traces to debug eviction logic. will tag PR once tests added. today: add unit test, run full bench on canary, and triage eviction traces.

drew: CR ping from me after tests. if all green we can schedule canary tonight. :thumbsup:

sam: leaving this for now, ping me if the canary shows p95 regressions.
